title: Honour Retry-After when redelivering webhooks
description:
Webhook receivers that rate-limit us send `Retry-After`; until now we ignored it and retried on our own exponential schedule, which got us blocked by two large customers.

- `parseRetryAfter` handles both the delay-seconds and HTTP-date forms and caps the wait at 10 minutes
- the dispatcher waits `max(backoff, Retry-After)` before the next attempt
